uniform.title: School uniform & appearance
uniform.intro: One uniform worn identically across our NECTA and Cambridge streams. The official colours are cream, sky-blue trim, and navy blue.
uniform.buy: Uniform details, sizing and fitting samples are available at the admissions office in Kisakasaka upon registration.
uniform.note: School uniform and sports kit fees are communicated separately upon admission. Spare stock is kept at the school office to support families.
